title: Art. 9.2 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 9 - Passenger Data Exchange Systems, A. General, 9.2
content: Recommended Practice. Contracting States and aircraft operators should provide the appropriate level, on a 24/7 (continuous) basis, of operational and technical support to analyse and respond to any system outage or failure in order to return to standard operations as soon as practicable.
